productionQueue.title: Qualité adaptative et préparation des shaders
productionQueue.notes: AdaptiveQualityController (Core/Platform/AdaptiveQuality.cs): p95 of the frame work time over 10 s windows (in-place selection, no allocation), two windows over 90 % of the budget lower one step, 60 s under 65 % raise one step up to the device tier, a failed raise doubles the wait (max 4 min). Ten steps per direction in the order Life, Ground, Weather, Shadows, Resolution; shadows never above resolution. Heat (ThermalMonitor, Android PowerManager thermal status API 29+, polled every 5 s): Serious lowers one step at once with a HUD note (quality.thermal_notice), Critical goes to Low at 30 FPS, Fair blocks raises, 60 s cool restores. Manual mode (Fluide, Equilibree, Magnifique) saved per device; only heat lowers it. QualityService reads the work time from FrameTimingManager (max of main thread, render thread, GPU) and applies the renderer part: quality level, lower shadow settings written onto the active URP asset and always restored. VerticalSliceEntry.ApplyQuality sends each step to life, scatter, streamer, weather, atmosphere, sun and blob shadows. Render scales aligned on doc 07 (0.8, 0.9, 1.0). Shader preparation: the benchmark player records graphics states (-pw-trace-graphics, one trace per boot), ShaderWarmupPipeline merges them into GSC_WindowsPlayer_Direct3D12 (45 variants, 75 states) and SVC_Game (29 fallback variants), DEF_ShaderWarmup wired in SC_Bootstrap; the boot step warms them in batches of 16 polled jobs (74 ms, longest loading frame 25.6 ms). Windows player: first cold run without warmup had 47 ms (W2) and 42 ms (Q1) frames; with warmup the longest frame of all 20 scenarios is 17.5 ms, 0 over 33 ms, Q1 walks the 20 steps with at most 16.8 ms after a step, overlaps 0. A later run without warmup also stays at 17.6 ms because the NVIDIA driver keeps compiled pipelines on disk: the gain shows only cold, as on a fresh phone install. Android has only the variant fallback until a Vulkan trace on real devices (T66). Tests: AdaptiveQualityTests 15, AdaptiveQualityPlayTests 2; EditMode 375/375, PlayMode 37 + 1 explicit skip. Report: Docs/Performance/T34_Qualite_Adaptative.md.
